author: scchm
quote:
The game is just boring. Humourless (Cal is not funny) and takes itself too seriously. There's a reason Dan Houser left. The game plays it too safe and as a consequence nothing is interesting. 

On top of the gameplay being boring, the writing is horrendous. I don't know who allowed this poor quality writing to pass but the story is filled with pacing issues, clunky dialogue, stale personalities and zero enjoyable pay off. The very worst heist mission from GTA 5 is infinitely better that the best of GTA 6. 

When the best part of the game is everything outside of the story mode, you've got a bad story. A disappointing 13 year wait.
